issues.title: Editorial: missing BCP 14 references, phrasing improvements
issues.author: clemensv
issues.body:
The following minor editorial issues were found during review:

### 1. Missing BCP 14 references (RFC2119, RFC8174)

The document uses RFC 2119 keywords (MUST, MAY, etc.) but does not list `RFC2119` and `RFC8174` in the normative references. These should be added.

### 2. Awkward phrasing in identity description

> The identity declaration functions similarly to a primary key in relational databases.

Suggested: "The identity declaration serves much like a primary key in a relational database."

### 3. Modal placement: "MUST only be used"

> The `relations` keyword MUST only be used with schemas of type `object` or `tuple`.

Per RFC style convention, prefer "MUST be used only with…" for clearer scoping of the restriction.

pulls.title: Editorial: add BCP 14 references and improve phrasing
pulls.author: clemensv
pulls.body:
- Add RFC2119 and RFC8174 to normative references (required for MUST/MAY keyword usage)
- Improve phrasing of identity keyword description
- Fix modal placement: 'MUST only be used' → 'MUST be used only'

Fixes #1
